sources.excerpt: "Every hard catalog obligation and all applicable hostile controls pass.",

Unknown predicate identity/version/digest or an undeclared domain value is outside-profile. A known predicate with wrong arity/sorts or a malformed atom is invalid-query. An exhausted computation is incomplete and never proves absence. Trace rendering can be truncated while the inspected closure remains complete; omitted indices stay visible. Output overflow instead emits an incomplete rendering result without an absence/application claim.

P09 must finish two diagnostic refinements identified during this review. An internal deadline-aware cancellation signal for a mapped worker must be distinguished from actual user cancellation in the unified facade. Also, its success-response validator should require concrete heads/transaction while allowing null retained fields in failure responses. These do not supply a publication capability; P08's live guard and commit path remain responsible for application. P09's plan records these refinements alongside the query-number trace normalization gap.

Use one bounded supported proposal in both combined and staged layouts, under identical semantic profile, fixed catalog and unchanged operator resource policy. Both successful paths must discharge all twenty obligations and agree on normalized predicate declarations, grounded rules, complete closure, certificates' semantic conclusions, source supports and theorem statement types. Compiled bytes, module partition and timings may differ. Also retain the rich target/scope cyclic fixture: a combined deadline refusal is a measured limitation, never evidence that the layout proved its obligations.

criteria.criterion: Every hard catalog obligation and all applicable hostile controls pass.
The combined/staged paths agree on semantic outputs under the same selected profile.
Failures retain diagnostic evidence and cannot publish a successor.

decisions.decision: Execute actual bounded combined/staged equivalence and fresh application paths under the same semantic profile; rich deadline refusal is a limitation rather than discharged proof.
decisions.basis: P09 full layout coverage under unchanged stage policy.

decisions.decision: Reuse accepted controls by exact current bindings; execute the new gaps without relabeling saved inspection as fresh completion.
Use an additive facade for query canonicalization, composed resource diagnostics and concrete success-response validation.
decisions.basis: P04/P08 definition gaps; accepted source bytes are preserved.

decisions.decision: Consumer jobs may use accepted P07 ownership and new P08 fixture stores; no accepted source or accepted store is modified.
